entries.title: 2014: A rocket carrying NASA's Cygnus CRS Orb-3 resupply mission to the International Space Station explodes seconds after taking off from the Mid-Atlantic Regional Spaceport in Wallops Island, Virginia.
entries.summary: Orbital-3, also known as Orb-3, was an attempted flight of Cygnus, an automated cargo spacecraft developed by United States–based company Orbital Sciences, on October 28, 2014. The mission was intended to launch at 22:22:38 UTC that evening.

entries.title: 2009: NASA successfully launches the Ares I-X mission, the only rocket launch for its short-lived Constellation program.
entries.summary: The National Aeronautics and Space Administration is an independent agency of the U.S. federal government responsible for the United States' civil space program, as well as research in aeronautics and space.

entries.title: 1971: Prospero becomes the only British satellite to be launched by a British rocket.
